title: 信息日报 2026-10-09

headline.title: 与 Meta 分道后，中国 Manus 首轮融资超 5 亿美元
headline.summary: TechCrunch 报道，中国 AI 公司 Manus 完成与 Meta 拆分后的首轮融资，规模超过 5 亿美元，由博裕资本与 IDG 资本领投，现有股东腾讯、HSG（原红杉中国）、真格基金等亦参与其中。
headline.title_en: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
headline.summary_en: TechCrunch reports that Manus, a Chinese AI company, has raised more than $500 million in its first funding round since separating from Meta. Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the round, while existing shareholders Tencent, HSG — formerly known as Sequoia China — and ZhenFund, among others, also participated. The round marks a significant vote of confidence in the company after the split and highlights continued investor interest in Chinese AI ventures.
headline.original_title: China’s Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
headline.reason: 该交易同时涉及 AI、创业融资与中国市场三条主线，是当日最具指标意义的商业新闻。
headline.reason_en: It combines AI, startup funding and China exposure in a single story, making it the most consequential business development of the day.
